svg.title: Ordered cumulative probabilities and proper prior implications

cc:Work.dc:title: Ordered cumulative probabilities and proper prior implications
cc:Work.dc:description: The gap between two cumulative logistic curves is the service probability. Prior category probabilities at centered predictors have wide intervals; center and corner numerical summaries are in the result record and chapter.
